physdesc.extent: 56 document boxes total including: 47 letter document boxes, 1 record storage box, 1 half-letter document box, 2 half-legal document boxes, and 5 legal document boxes. standard storage record box.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Records 10 years old and older are open for research, with select materials restricted as noted. Brittle or damaged materials are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection primarly consists of grant admininstration files, grantee correspondence, and select documentation of funding inquiries and declined grant requests.
Documentation of grants often includes: correspondence, events and invitations, publications, updates, summaries of past funding, and associated tax information.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Level 1: File-Level Access. Many records remain in original housing.
